maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from cannabis products sold through dispensaries and wholesale, which are consumables used up, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Cannabis dispensary sales are paid by consumers and medical patients out of pocket, not by government or insurers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Curaleaf grew through large acquisitions like Grassroots, but now grows mainly through its own retail and cultivation operations.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other dispensaries or cannabis brands; products are largely interchangeable and bought on price and preference.

notes: Curaleaf's acquisition-led history (Grassroots, Cura Partners) makes the serial-acquirer answer a judgment call.
